job.title: Embedded Software Developer
job.description:
Senior Embedded Software Engineer, Medical Devices Location: Melbourne (South-East suburbs), hybrid
Type: Contractor, full-time
About the company An established Australian product development and engineering firm with more than 20 years of experience bringing complex technology to market. The team builds products for medical, industrial and defence clients in regulated environments where safety and reliability are critical.
Their medical work covers Class II and Class III devices, including advanced cardiovascular technology, medical robotics and AI-enabled treatment platforms. You’ll work with electronics, mechanical, software, human factors and regulatory specialists on products that directly affect patient outcomes.
The role A senior, hands-on role designing and building embedded software for life-critical medical devices, from hardware bring-up through to the user interface. You’ll shape software architecture, set engineering standards and mentor others, while staying close to the code.
What you’ll do
  • Architect and develop embedded software in modern C/C++ across microcontroller, RTOS and embedded Linux platforms
  • Build device user interfaces and HMIs for touchscreen medical products
  • Design layered, reusable software platforms with clean hardware abstraction
  • Lead board bring-up and hardware/software integration with electronics engineers
  • Develop communication interfaces (BLE, Wi-Fi, TCP/IP, serial, CAN, USB)
  • Deliver under a formal medical software lifecycle, including requirements, architecture, risk analysis and verification
  • Set up and improve CI/CD, static analysis and automated testing
  • Lead design and code reviews and mentor engineers
  • Work directly with clients to shape requirements and present technical progress
What you’ll bring
  • Degree in Software, Electrical, Computer or Mechatronics Engineering (or similar)
  • 8+ years of commercial embedded software development in C and modern C++ (C++14/17)
  • Delivery of software for regulated medical devices under IEC 62304 and ISO 13485
  • Experience with RTOS (e.g. FreeRTOS, Zephyr, QNX) and embedded Linux
  • Embedded UI development with frameworks such as Qt/QML, LVGL or similar
  • Strong software architecture skills, including design patterns and platform abstraction
  • Comfort with schematics, debuggers and lab tools during bring-up
  • Experience leading or mentoring engineers in a small, high-ownership team
Highly regarded
  • Safety-critical experience beyond medical (e.g. IEC 61508, aerospace, ATM, automotive)
  • ISO 14971 risk management and medical device cybersecurity
  • CI/CD with Docker and GitHub Actions, plus static analysis (PC-lint, cppcheck) and TDD
  • Simulation, automated UI or screenshot regression testing
  • Practical use of AI-assisted and agentic coding tools in development
  • Python for test automation and tooling
Why apply
  • Build Class II and III devices that directly affect patient lives
  • Variety across clients, from start-ups to global medtech
  • Influence architecture and engineering practice, not just deliver tickets
  • Collaborative, engineering-led culture
  • Hybrid working in a growing team

job.title: Site Reliability Engineer
job.description:
The Opportunity
We're looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to join a team responsible for the reliability, performance and scalability of a large-scale SaaS platform used by organisations across Australia and internationally.

This is a hands-on role combining cloud infrastructure, DevOps, automation and software engineering. You'll play a key part in keeping the platform running smoothly, improving existing systems and introducing new technologies and processes to make things more efficient.

Working closely with engineering and product teams, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of technical challenges, reduce manual work through automation and contribute to the ongoing development of a critical platform.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Maintaining and improving the reliability, availability, performance and security of SaaS platforms.
  • Developing automation and writing code to reduce manual tasks and improve operational efficiency.
  • Managing and optimising cloud infrastructure and serverless services within Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Building, maintaining and improving CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes.
  • Troubleshooting technical issues and contributing to incident response and root cause analysis.
  • Supporting platform scalability, capacity planning and disaster recovery.
  • Working with engineering teams to understand technical requirements and deliver practical solutions.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve platform performance, infrastructure and engineering practices.
What We're Looking For
  • Experience in Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps, Cloud Engineering or Platform Engineering.
  • An understanding of cloud infrastructure and serverless technologies, ideally within Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with Linux operating systems and troubleshooting.
  • Exposure to Docker and containerisation technologies.
  • Experience with infrastructure automation and scripting using Bash, Python or similar languages.
  • Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, CircleCI or Travis CI.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform.
  • Experience working with MySQL databases and basic SQL.
Why Consider This Opportunity?
  • Work on a SaaS platform supporting large organisations nationally and internationally.
  • Gain exposure to Google Cloud technologies and modern serverless architecture.
  • Access company-supported Google Cloud training and certifications to support your professional development.

job.title: Senior Project Manager - Retail Technology
job.description:
We're looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager / Delivery Lead to lead a major enterprise retail technology program in Melbourne.

You'll take ownership of the end-to-end delivery of a next-generation Point of Sale and unified commerce platform, acting as the key link between the customer, technology delivery teams and third-party partners.

The program will progress from discovery and solution definition through build, pilot and implementation, giving you ownership across the full delivery lifecycle.

What you'll be doing
  • Own delivery across scope, schedule, budget, quality and resourcing
  • Establish and manage project governance, SteerCos, reporting, RAID and change control
  • Coordinate structured discovery, requirements and solution design workshops
  • Manage senior customer stakeholders and executive-level communications
  • Build and maintain integrated delivery plans, milestones and dependencies
  • Coordinate internal technical teams, third-party vendors and implementation partners
  • Manage project financials, SOW deliverables and commercial change requests
  • Lead delivery through solution definition, build, configuration, UAT and pilot deployment
  • Manage risks, issues and escalation pathways
  • Coordinate transition into ongoing support following implementation
What we're looking for
  • 8+ years' experience delivering large-scale enterprise technology programs
  • Strong end-to-end project or program delivery experience
  • Experience delivering customer-facing professional services or complex technology implementations
  • Strong governance, RAID, executive reporting and stakeholder management capability
  • Commercial experience managing budgets, SOWs and change requests
  • Experience coordinating third-party vendors and multidisciplinary technology teams
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent experience/certification
Experience delivering POS, store systems, unified commerce or broader retail technology programs would be highly regarded.

You'll be joining a highly visible program requiring someone who can bring structure to complexity, confidently manage senior stakeholders and maintain strong commercial and delivery discipline throughout.

job.title: Senior Business Analyst - Retail Technology
job.description:
We're looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join a major retail technology program delivering a next-generation Point of Sale and unified commerce platform.

You'll sit at the intersection of retail operations and technology, working closely with client stakeholders, product owners, architects, developers and testers to translate complex store and customer requirements into practical technology solutions.

This is a hands-on BA role suited to someone who understands how technology operates within a complex retail environment – from checkout and payments through to promotions, loyalty, inventory and integration with surrounding enterprise platforms.

What you'll be doing
  • Lead requirements workshops and discovery sessions with business, store operations and technology stakeholders
  • Translate requirements into user stories, functional specifications, process flows and acceptance criteria
  • Map current and future-state processes and identify gaps, configuration requirements and potential customisation
  • Work closely with architects and engineering teams throughout solution design
  • Manage requirements traceability from discovery through build, testing and go-live
  • Support SIT and UAT, including test scenarios, acceptance criteria and defect triage
  • Manage and refine requirements within an Agile delivery environment
  • Support business readiness, training and change activities
  • Build strong relationships across both technical and non-technical stakeholder groups
What we're looking for
  • 5+ years' experience as a Business Analyst delivering enterprise technology projects
  • Strong retail technology experience, ideally across POS, checkout or store systems
  • Understanding of retail processes including payments, promotions, loyalty and inventory
  • Strong requirements elicitation, workshop facilitation and process mapping skills
  • Experience producing user stories, functional specifications and acceptance criteria
  • Experience supporting SIT/UAT and working closely with engineering and QA teams
  • Agile delivery experience and familiarity with Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
This is an opportunity to work on a significant enterprise retail technology transformation with exposure across the full lifecycle from requirements and solution design through to implementation.

job.title: Engineering Manager
job.description:
Engineering Manager 

Our client builds commerce technology used by major retailers around the world, point of sale, mobile, self-service and back-of-store operations. It's an established, well-resourced global technology company with a strong footprint in the retail tech space.

We're hiring Engineering Managers to lead teams building the next chapter of the platform: AI-native development tooling, an agentic platform layer, and a genuinely engineering-owned delivery model. There's no PMO running the schedule here, the engineering chain owns outcomes end to end, with Technical Program Managers, QA and DevOps supporting delivery rather than owning it.

What you'll own:
  • Delivery, quality and team health for one or more product areas
  • Hiring, performance, coaching and the hard conversations for your team
  • Enough technical depth to be useful in design reviews, debug production issues, and partner with Principal Engineers on standards
  • Customer escalations and SLAs affecting your scope
Must have:
  • A strong engineering background with a track record of shipping production systems at scale
  • Demonstrated leadership of engineers, as a manager, tech lead or staff/senior IC who's owned end-to-end delivery
  • Comfort moving between architecture and the debugger, and between an exec review and a sprint standup, in the same day
  • Working knowledge of modern Agile delivery, SDLC and CI/CD in a continuous-deployment environment
  • A track record of owning a missed commitment without deflection, and recovering from a production incident
This role spans a wide seniority range, matched to your experience, team size and product complexity. Strong tech leads looking to move into management for the first time are just as welcome to apply as experienced managers leading larger groups.

job.title: Facilities Manager
job.description:
Facilities Manager – SA State Government
Location: Mawson Lakes, SA
Employment: Full-time
Contract: ASAP - June 2027
Rate: $69–$71 per hour + superannuation
An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Facilities Manager to join a South Australian State Government department based in Mawson Lakes.
This is a hands-on facilities and asset management role where you will play an important part in ensuring facilities are safe, well-maintained, compliant and operating effectively. You will work closely with contractors, suppliers, internal stakeholders and other government agencies to deliver high-quality facilities services and maintenance outcomes.
About the role As Facilities Manager, you will be responsible for the day-to-day management of facilities services, maintenance programs and external service providers across a portfolio of assets.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Managing facilities maintenance, including preventative maintenance, repairs, upgrades and improvement works.
  • Developing and managing facilities budgets, monitoring expenditure and identifying opportunities for cost efficiencies.
  • Managing relationships with contractors, suppliers and service providers to ensure quality, timely and compliant delivery.
  • Monitoring contractor performance against contracts, KPIs and service level expectations.
  • Conducting regular inspections and coordinating corrective actions to ensure facilities meet relevant building, safety and industry requirements.
  • Monitoring the condition and performance of buildings, plant and equipment and developing appropriate maintenance and replacement strategies.
  • Working with internal teams and external partners to plan and deliver facilities improvement projects.
  • Responding to and resolving facilities-related issues, complaints and stakeholder concerns.
  • Building strong relationships with a broad range of stakeholders and providing practical advice on facilities matters.
  • Identifying opportunities to improve facilities processes, systems and service delivery.
About you We are looking for an experienced facilities or property professional who can confidently manage competing priorities, contractors and stakeholder expectations.
You will ideally have:
  • Demonstrated experience in facilities, property or asset management.
  • Strong experience managing contractors, suppliers and service providers.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Experience managing budgets and monitoring expenditure.
  • Strong knowledge of facilities maintenance, compliance and building requirements.
  • The ability to identify issues, assess options and implement practical solutions.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a busy environment.
  • Relevant tertiary qualifications in property or a related discipline are highly desirable, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Property Manager Registration is required.
What’s on offer?
  • Full-time opportunity with a South Australian State Government department.
  • Based in Mawson Lakes.
  • Attractive hourly rate of $69–$71 per hour + superannuation.
  • Opportunity to work across a varied property and facilities portfolio.
  • A role with significant stakeholder engagement and responsibility.
  • The opportunity to contribute to the effective management and improvement of government assets.
A current satisfactory National Police Clearance will be required for the successful candidate. Some out-of-hours work and interstate/intrastate travel may also be required.
If you are an experienced Facilities Manager looking for your next opportunity within South Australian Government, we would love to hear from you.

An innovative, venture-backed Australian MedTech company is developing next-generation monitoring technology designed to improve clinical decision-making and patient outcomes during childbirth.

Bringing together specialists across software, hardware, electronics, clinical research and data science, the business is continuing to develop and advance its innovative medical technology.

They are now looking for a Senior Embedded Software Engineer to join their multidisciplinary engineering team.

The Opportunity
This is a hands-on engineering role working across embedded software, hardware and regulated medical-device development.

You will design, develop and test reliable software using C/C++ within Linux and embedded environments. Working alongside firmware, hardware, clinical and regulatory specialists, you will support the development and integration of a complex connected medical device.

What You’ll Be Doing
  • Designing and developing embedded software using C/C++.
  • Working across Linux, RTOS and embedded-device environments.
  • Integrating software with hardware and connected devices.
  • Supporting BLE, NFC and other device communication workflows.
  • Developing unit, integration and system-level tests.
  • Debugging complex software, hardware and connectivity issues.
  • Supporting secure OTA updates, rollback and recovery.
  • Producing documentation and traceability for a regulated medical-device environment.
  • Contributing to software verification and validation activities.
What We’re Looking For
  • Strong commercial C/C++ development experience.
  • Experience working with Linux and embedded systems.
  • Experience integrating software with hardware or connected devices.
  • Knowledge of communication protocols such as BLE, NFC, I2C, SPI or UART.
  • Experience within MedTech, embedded systems or another regulated or safety-critical environment.
  • Experience with IEC 62304, ISO 13485, IEC 60601, Qt/QML, RTOS or secure OTA updates would be advantageous but is not essential.
Why Consider It?
  • Work on technology with the potential to make a meaningful difference to mothers and babies.
  • Solve complex challenges spanning software, hardware and connected devices.
  • Remain deeply hands-on without taking on formal people-management responsibilities.

job.title: Senior WHS Advisor

Are you an experienced Work Health and Safety professional looking for an opportunity to make a meaningful impact across a complex and diverse organisation?

This is an opportunity to work with leaders, employees, volunteers and external stakeholders to strengthen safety culture, improve WHS systems and support best-practice health and safety outcomes.

About the Role
As a Senior WHS Advisor, you will provide trusted technical advice and practical support across a broad range of work health and safety matters.
You will contribute to the development, implementation and continuous improvement of WHS systems, policies, procedures and programs, while helping build safety capability and ownership across the organisation.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Providing expert WHS advice and leadership to managers, executives, employees and volunteers.
  • Building strong and productive relationships with stakeholders at all levels.
  • Supporting the development, implementation and maintenance of WHS management systems and strategic work plans.
  • Developing, reviewing and implementing WHS policies, procedures, guidelines and supporting documentation.
  • Monitoring and reporting on hazards, incidents, trends and WHS performance data.
  • Providing advice and reporting to WHS committees and other governance forums.
  • Undertaking incident investigations and supporting the development of appropriate preventative and corrective actions.
  • Developing, implementing and evaluating internal WHS audit programs.
  • Supporting external audits and compliance verification activities.
  • Identifying system gaps and developing practical corrective action plans.
  • Providing technical advice on WHS legislation, regulations, Australian Standards, codes of practice and organisational policies.
  • Supporting risk management activities and the identification and control of workplace hazards.
  • Contributing to safety initiatives that improve organisational capability, performance and continuous improvement.
  • Monitoring WHS programs and services to ensure agreed outcomes, objectives and performance measures are achieved.
  • Preparing clear, accurate and timely WHS reports, presentations and briefing materials.
  • Supporting and mentoring other WHS professionals and contributing to a collaborative team environment.
About You:

You will be an experienced WHS professional who can operate confidently at both a strategic and operational level.
You will have:
  • Strong knowledge and practical application of Work Health and Safety legislation and associated regulatory requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience providing WHS advice within a complex organisation.
  • Experience developing and maintaining WHS management systems, policies and procedures.
  • Strong understanding of risk management principles and their practical application.
  • Experience conducting or supporting workplace investigations, audits and risk assessments.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyse WHS data, identify trends and prepare meaningful reports.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical information clearly to a range of audiences.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and relationship-building skills.
  • The ability to influence, negotiate and provide credible advice to leaders and operational teams.
  • Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines.
  • A proactive approach to identifying risks, opportunities and areas for improvement.
  • Demonstrated commitment to continuous improvement and building positive safety cultures.
  • The ability to work collaboratively while also operating with a high degree of autonomy.
Experience applying recognised risk management frameworks and public sector WHS, safety, audit, wellbeing or injury management requirements will be highly regarded.

Please note a current police check will be required.  Only short listed candidates with relevant experience will be contacted.

job.title: Senior Business Analyst

We’re partnering with an established organisation undergoing significant transformation to find a Senior Business Analyst who can bring strong delivery capability, but just as importantly, help lift the capability of the broader BA team.
  
This isn’t a role for someone who simply wants to gather requirements and move onto the next project. You’ll work closely with an existing team of BAs, helping take a good function to the next level through coaching, mentoring, stronger standards and consistent ways of working.
  
You’ll be responsible for:
  • Coaching and mentoring BAs, helping develop their capability and confidence
  • Owning and continuously improving BA standards, frameworks and ways of working
  • Leading complex initiatives from discovery and requirements through to implementation and BAU handover
  • Facilitating workshops and working closely with senior and executive stakeholders
  • Translating complex business problems into practical solution options and recommendations
  • Current and future-state process mapping, gap analysis and continuous improvement
  • Producing high-quality requirements, process documentation and analysis artefacts
  • Acting as a trusted advisor across business, transformation and technology teams
  • Working across both Agile and Waterfall delivery environments
  
You’ll ideally bring:
  • Strong end-to-end Business Analysis experience across complex transformation initiatives
  • Demonstrated experience coaching, mentoring or uplifting other BAs
  • Experience establishing or improving BA standards, templates, playbooks or quality
  • Confidence engaging with senior leaders and constructively challenging stakeholders
  • Strong workshop facilitation, requirements and process improvement capability
  • The ability to operate across both strategic thinking and detailed delivery
  • Experience across technology-enabled transformation and complex system change
  
If you’re an experienced BA who gets as much satisfaction from developing people and improving how a team operates as you do from delivering the work yourself, I’d be keen to hear from you.
